key_issues.description: Seed 44 has a broken English construction that produces ungrammatical output.
Arabic uses أتعلم (I learn) where English says 'I want to know' - should be أعرف (I know).
Seed 34 produces broken English 'whenever there is the others' - grammatically incorrect.
Missing tanwin/accusative marking (جاهزاً) and plural agreement (جاهزين) after يكون.
Arabic 'لن الآن' ungrammatical - لن requires a following verb.

summary.overall_assessment: Round 3 shows moderate quality with average score 5.66/9. 46% of phrases score 7+, but 24% fall below 5. Critical issues: Seeds 44 and 34 have systematic English generation errors. The Arabic is generally better than the English, with most Arabic errors being minor (case marking, preposition choice). The know/learn (أعرف/أتعلم) confusion is a significant translation error that appears multiple times. Fragments tend to score lower. Recommend fixing seeds 44 and 34 English templates, and reviewing the know/learn LEGO mapping.
